Amazon Bedrock expands API support and introduces Cross Region Inferencing for OpenAI models in AWS GovCloud (US)
changes.detail: Amazon Bedrock now supports the OpenAI GPT-5.6 models (Terra and Luna) on the bedrock-runtime endpoint, with support for the Responses, Converse, and Chat Completions APIs in AWS GovCloud (US). It also adds support for cross-Region inference, allowing customers to use cross-Region inference within AWS GovCloud (US) regions to access higher throughput and increased redundancy. Cross-Region inference automatically routes inference requests across both AWS GovCloud (US) Regions to give you higher throughput, without you needing to manage capacity across multiple Regions.
